message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime label(s) for this case.

Facts: Wu (defendant) involved in concealment/transfer of shares that are proceeds from illegal public deposit (illegal fundraising). The case mentions that Wu concealed and transferred shares that are proceeds of illegal public deposit crime. So the crime is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". According to correction lessons: When defendant hides and also gains profit from crime, need both "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得" and "犯罪所得收益". The lesson says: "关键在于被告人不仅掩饰、隐瞒了犯罪所得（收购盗窃得来的摩托车），而且以低价收购获取了价值差额的收益，构成‘犯罪所得收益’。因此不能只标记为掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得，还需加上犯罪所得收益。规则：若行为人明知是犯罪所得并收购，同时因价格低于实际价值而取得经济利益，应同时适用‘掩饰、隐蔽犯罪所得’和‘犯罪所得收益’。" In this case, Wu concealed shares that are proceeds of illegal public deposit. He also transferred them, likely for profit? The description: He concealed and transferred 16.66% shares to hide assets from creditors. The crime is laundering (money laundering) of illegal public deposit proceeds. The label likely "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". The case also mentions illegal public deposit (非法吸收公众存款) but that is the underlying crime of other defendants (Hu, Zhou). Wu is not the one who did illegal public deposit; he is involved in laundering. So we need to label the laundering crime.

Thus answer: [罪名]掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益<eoa>

Check if any other crimes apply: Possibly "洗钱" is the term, but label is as above.

Thus final answer JSON.
